Select the trip end date and enter the driver income for display. This amount is only for showing driver income, it is not used in calculations. Tap Submit to complete the trip and download the PDF for sharing.

Interactive Scenario Simulator: What if Return Load is:

When a truck delivers goods from A to B and returns empty (B to A), it still consumes fuel, toll, driver time, and wear without earning anything. This is called Deadhead / Empty Return.\n\nA Return Load (Backhaul) lets you take cargo on the way back, recovering costs and turning an empty loss into pure profit.

Why add a Safety Reserve?

• Helps account for highway traffic, diversions, and delays.
• Accounts for heavy truck loads and gradient hills.
• Covers cabin idling and AC fuel consumption.
• Prevents sludge/air entering fuel injectors on low tanks.

We recommend keeping at least a 20% safety margin for peace of mind.
